changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Advanced the LibertAI NVFP4 snapshot to caca4e6a.
changes.details: The complete 131-file inventory is refreshed from 92d8bfb9 to caca4e6a. All 120 weight shards and runtime configuration files are byte-identical; only the upstream README changed, increasing the exact inventory by 1,690 bytes. The Ray TP2 runtime, admission envelope, and Candidate acceptance state remain unchanged; installed containers must be recreated.

changes.summary: Corrected the dual-Spark execution backend to Ray.
changes.details: MiaAI-Lab's authoritative start.sh launches a Ray head and worker before vLLM; the existing runtime wrapper implements that exercised Ray TP2 topology. No runtime distribution, image, model, or launch-profile pin changed.

changes.summary: Corrected the dual-Spark GLM public build host allowlist.
changes.details: Added pypi.org for ordinary pip resolution and removed docker.io because the digest-pinned base image is transferred separately.

The model-input-scales payload now contains real calibrated per-projection scales instead of 1.0 placeholders, preventing FP8 block-scale underflow and the reported long-context repetition failure. All 120 original weight shards remain byte-identical; a physical long-context semantic regression remains required before acceptance.

The immutable snapshot adds per-expert input_scale=1.0 tensors required by vLLM's NVFP4 MoE alpha fold, expands fused-module quantization exclusions, and retains the byte-identical 120 original weight shards.

changes.summary: Selected vLLM's deepseek_r1 reasoning parser instead of the SGLang-only glm45 parser.
Kept the two-Spark Ray profile Candidate pending a fresh build and physical semantic canary.
Added an executable two-Spark GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 vLLM Candidate.
changes.details: The recipe pins LibertAI's complete public 181 GiB checkpoint and rebuilds MiaAI-Lab's public SM121 sparse-MLA patch with FlashInfer 0.6.18, exact NCCL 2.30.7, Ray TP2, multimodal serving, FP8 KV cache, and MTP4.
